outcome: A changed requirement or failed domain run is repaired locally while unrelated accepted work stays current.
currentProblem: Static successful delivery does not demonstrate a usable iterative development process.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.
successCriteria: A real requirement change invalidates only affected outputs and drives the owning domains to a newly verified release.
Kill/resume and duplicate activation preserve attempt identity and one logical external publication.
An old worker and stale deployment observation cannot close changed work; unrelated accepted outputs remain current.
